method: Every 3 completed block read at unchanged native marked RGB positions and unmarked NIR context; actual literal pixel/asset/mask/SCL values retained. Finite human-defined visibility exceptions; no threshold/model classifier, source/imagery/raster operation or remote reread.
source_quality: All 58 points in-frame/masks255; validity is not surface truth. SCL10 at 9579/9580/9581 conflicts with visually clear wave-textured sea and is retained explicitly; it is not promoted to cloud truth.

blocks.finding: The eastern horizontal group and two isolated positions lie in visible sea. The southern isolated position touches fine reef-rim detail and remains water-versus-exposed-material unresolved; reef morphology elsewhere is not extrapolated to it.

Three eastern positions are visible wave-textured sea despite literal SCL10 at their centres: SCL is retained as a source-product contradiction, not label-only truth. Two western positions cross fine mottled reef/lagoon edge and bright ridge material; exact water-cover versus exposed reef/sand requires local resolution. Visible built features farther south do not determine either centre.
All 32 arc points lie in clear sea south of the reef, with continuous wave texture. A vertical radiometric seam farther east is not land or a coverage gap at the centres.
